# Forbidden attribution patterns for commit messages, code, docs, and pull requests
(?i)co-authored-by:.*(claude|github-actions|bot|ai|chatgpt|openai|anthropic|copilot|gemini|deepmind|cursor|v0)
(?i)signed-off-by:.*(claude|github-actions|bot|ai|chatgpt|openai|anthropic|copilot|gemini|deepmind|cursor|v0)
(?i)generated (with|by)
(?i)ai-assisted
(?i)created (with|by) (claude|chatgpt|gemini|cursor|v0|copilot)
